name: Human3.6M: Large Scale Dataset for 3D Human Sensing
description: One of the largest and most widely cited motion capture datasets for 3D human sensing and articulated posture recovery. Captured in a synchronized multi-modal optical environment consisting of 4 calibrated high-resolution 50Hz digital video cameras, a 10-camera Vicon motion capture system, and Time-of-Flight sensors. Features 11 professional actors performing 17 varied motion scenarios such as discussion, smoking, taking photos, walking, and greeting.
